statement: OpenCode's pinned permission service evaluates wildcard rules in order with the last matching rule taking precedence, defaults unresolved requests to ask, and distinguishes deny, one-time approval, persistent approval, and rejection through explicit request/reply events.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 OpenCode permission service 按顺序计算 wildcard rule，并由最后一个匹配项决定结果；未命中时默认 ask，同时通过显式 request/reply event 区分 deny、单次批准、持续批准和拒绝。
display_text.en: OpenCode's pinned permission service uses last-match wildcard rules, defaults unresolved requests to ask, and represents deny, one-time approval, persistent approval, and rejection explicitly.

evidence.title: OpenCode permission service
evidence.locator: evaluate, ask, reply, and ruleset merge

notes: This is semantic authorization logic. It is not evidence of OS-level filesystem, process, or network isolation.
